title: feat(emergency): implement 911 operations command service, rapid response unit dispatch, on-scene arrival tracking, and facility directory
author: SmartCity360 Architecture Team
problem: Municipal public safety command lacked an integrated real-time dispatch engine for coordinating fire, ambulance, and police squads with automatic availability toggling and on-scene milestone tracking.
solution: Built EmergencyService with lifecycle state machine (REPORTED, DISPATCHED, RESPONDING, CONTAINED, RESOLVED, CLOSED). Implemented team dispatch with automatic unit availability lock, on-scene arrival timestamping, containment verification, incident resolution with automated squad release, and public safety facility directory queries.
security_considerations: Restricted dispatch commands, validated caller identity, audit timestamps, and emergency team isolation.
